render.prompt: Character design reference for a cozy retro top-down adventure game: a scruffy, curious seagull with a wide cream chest, teal-grey wing tips, a hooked beak with a coral spot, one foot raised, and a canvas satchel stuffed with crumpled paper fortune slips. Full body, front view, standing upright facing the viewer, centered, chunky cute proportions with a big head. 16-bit pixel art style, clean flat colours, bold dark outline, simple readable shapes. Plain solid flat magenta background, no shadow, no text, no frame.
